evals.name: text-to-image-pro-landscape-en
evals.prompt: Generate a photorealistic image of a serene mountain lake at sunrise, with soft mist rising off the water and warm golden light on the peaks. Cinematic 35mm film look. Please make it widescreen 16:9 and use nano banana pro.
evals.expected_output: A single image file saved locally (in ./kie-output/ or similar), plus the KIE task id and remote URL printed. The image should be 16:9, photorealistic, generated by nano-banana-pro.

evals.name: text-to-image-nb2-portrait-th
evals.prompt: ช่วยสร้างภาพร้านกาแฟเล็ก ๆ ในซอยเงียบ ๆ ย่านเมืองเก่า มีไฟสีอุ่นส่องออกมาจากหน้าต่าง ตอนเย็นใกล้มืด บรรยากาศอบอุ่นชวนเข้าไปนั่ง เป็นภาพแนวตั้ง 9:16 ใช้ nano-banana-2 ได้เลย
evals.expected_output: A single image file saved locally, 9:16 aspect ratio, generated by nano-banana-2. The remote URL and task id should also be printed.

evals.name: image-to-image-pro-style-transfer
evals.prompt: Here's a reference image in Van Gogh's Starry Night style: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/e/ea/Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg/800px-Van_Gogh_-_Starry_Night_-_Google_Art_Project.jpg — please generate a new image of a quiet Japanese fishing village at night in the same swirling post-impressionist style. Use nano-banana-pro, 16:9.
evals.expected_output: A single image file showing a Japanese village scene rendered in a Van Gogh post-impressionist style. The reference URL should have been passed to the API as image_input. 16:9 aspect ratio, nano-banana-pro.
